reader_summary.overview: In this episode of PortfolioCasts | Investor Portfolio Podcasts, we analyze the portfolio of Howard Marks and Oaktree Capital Management. Oaktree specializes in credit, distressed debt, and value-oriented investments, guided by strong risk management and market cycle awareness. Holdings covered include:TRMD, VNOM, FCX, VALE, NOK, NU, GRAB, ITUB, LBTYA, CX, SBLK, NBR, FTAI, KRC, BHC, JBS, YMM, CRC, BATL, and more.

 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In January 20 Howard Marks - Oaktree Capital: Cycle-Aware Investing Explained PortfolioCasts | Investor Portfolio Podcasts 12m In this episode of PortfolioCasts | Investor Portfolio Podcasts , we analyze the portfolio of Howard Marks and Oaktree Capital Management .

 Oaktree specializes in credit, distressed debt, and value-oriented investments, guided by strong risk management and market cycle awareness.

 Holdings covered include:
TRMD, VNOM, FCX, VALE, NOK, NU, GRAB, ITUB, LBTYA, CX, SBLK, NBR, FTAI, KRC, BHC, JBS, YMM, CRC, BATL, and more.

 This episode covers:• Cycle-aware investing principles• Credit and distressed strategies• Risk control and downside protection
